title: Skill integration: operator channel in runner prompts
description: Serves fact A19. Rough scope (flesh out when epic 2 closes, against the real command surface): agent-runner.md gains an Operator channel section with the routing table (requires/awaiting gates → tk ask with buttons; blocked-with-live-frontier → park + tk tell; blocked-and-stalled → tk ask escalation; checkpoint → tk tell report + tk ask sign-off; completion → tk tell; planning → never, in-session tools). Wire into blocked-agent steps, await-handling table, completion report, and gate-clearing rules; one clause in SKILL.md planning-is-interactive doctrine; ask-bar-unchanged sentence + retro interrupt audit reference; workers never touch the channel (orchestrator only); prompts say operator channel, not Telegram. Edit skills/ticks/ only (source of truth), runner-neutral parts in references/agent-runner.md.
